name: RecipeCostingMenuEngineering
tagline: Cost every dish, hit your food cost target and engineer the menu – stars, plowhorses, puzzles and dogs in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete recipe costing and menu engineering app for restaurants, hotel F&B, groups and central kitchens: recipe lines with yields and unit conversion, plate cost with a Q-factor, food cost and gross profit on tax-inclusive prices, suggested prices for the target food cost, the Kasavana & Smith matrix per menu section with recommendations, an ingredient catalogue with price mismatches and what-if supplier price changes, and the costing workflow with role rules. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Recipe-line costing: qty unit ingredient @ cost/unit (yield %)
Plate cost with Q-factor and portions
Food cost % and GP on net (tax-exclusive) prices
Target food cost per dish with tolerance
Kasavana & Smith matrix: stars, plowhorses, puzzles, dogs
Ingredient spend, share and price mismatches
What-if supplier price change applied to every recipe
Draft → costed → approved → on menu → retired with role rules and manager override
Bulk re-cost, reprice, approve, retire; undo; CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (RecipeCardText, MatrixJson, IngredientsJson)
